purpose: Hard region requirements and working boundary rules used by the planner. Current Equilibrium sources take priority; Catalyst is used only as historical League evidence where the new League has not published a finer boundary.

boundary_overrides.planner_rule: Treat Burthorpe, Death Plateau, Trollheim, Troll Stronghold and the God Wars Dungeon approach as Asgarnia. Do not expose them as another selectable region.
boundary_overrides.evidence_note: Equilibrium explicitly lists God Wars Dungeon under Asgarnia. Catalyst locality labels also put Burthorpe, the Troll Stronghold herb patch and God Wars Dungeon tasks under Asgarnia.

boundary_overrides.planner_rule: Use Misthalin as the working League region for Fort Forinthry content. Catalyst explicitly labelled Fort Forinthry tasks as Misthalin; Equilibrium has not yet published a finer Fort locality rule.
boundary_overrides.evidence_note: Historical League locality evidence only; do not present this as an Equilibrium-specific boundary reveal.

boundary_overrides.planner_rule: Use Misthalin as the working League region for City of Um / Underworld content until Equilibrium publishes its own locality override.
boundary_overrides.evidence_note: Catalyst explicitly labelled City of Um tasks as Misthalin.

boundary_overrides.planner_rule: Use Misthalin as the working League region for Zanaris/Cosmic-Altar access. Catalyst filed entering Zanaris via Lumbridge Swamp and crafting cosmic runes under Misthalin.
boundary_overrides.evidence_note: Working historical League taxonomy; Equilibrium-specific exceptions remain unpublished.

boundary_overrides.planner_rule: Use Misthalin as the working League taxonomy for Senntisten-linked content unless a specific encounter has a separately established region mapping. This is historical/entrance evidence, not an Equilibrium-specific reveal.
boundary_overrides.evidence_note: Catalyst grouped Elder God Wars/Senntisten-adjacent content with Misthalin/Varrock; the Senntisten Dig Site is accessed from the Varrock Dig Site.

dependencies.planner_rule: Dungeoneering through Daemonheim requires the Forinthry/Wilderness region.
Burthorpe, Death Plateau, Trollheim and Troll Stronghold resolve to Asgarnia unless a later Equilibrium source explicitly changes the boundary.

cross_boundary_cases.content: The Zamorakian Undercity / Zamorak, Lord of Chaos
cross_boundary_cases.planner_rule: Do not mark ED4/Zamorak as requiring only Misthalin or only Forinthry until Equilibrium publishes how cross-boundary dungeon/arena access is resolved. Preserve both sides as a dependency warning.
cross_boundary_cases.evidence_note: The Undercity entrance/escape returns to Senntisten, while its portal chain reaches the Wilderness Crater and Zamorak. This is a real base-game boundary split, not a guess.

destination_side.location: The Arc / Wushanko Isles (Seiryu, Temple of Aminishi / ED1, Waiko seasinger residual)

cross_boundary_cases.planner_rule: Package The Arc / Wushanko as Asgarnia for Equilibrium planning (user rule 2026-07-26). Seiryu, ED1 Temple of Aminishi, and seasinger residual densify under Asgarnia. Optional Desert Ports pressure may be added later; leave Asgarnia-only for now.
cross_boundary_cases.evidence_note: User taxonomy 2026-07-26: Seiryu/Arc → Asgarnia (maybe Desert later; leave Asgarnia for now). Matches existing skilling packaging (asgarnia:arc-skilling-access / Waiko shop).

entry_side.location: World Gate south of Eagles' Peak

cross_boundary_cases.planner_rule: Do not classify Tarddiad as Kandarin because the World Gate is reached from the Eagles' Peak side of Gielinor. Tarddiad is another world and remains unmapped until Equilibrium publishes how World Gate destinations are treated.
cross_boundary_cases.evidence_note: The World Gate is south of Eagles' Peak, while Tarddiad is explicitly another world unlocked through The Light Within. Entry geography is not destination-region evidence.

destination_side.location: Mazcab (Liberation of Mazcab / Achto / teci sinks)

cross_boundary_cases.planner_rule: Package Mazcab as Desert for Equilibrium planning (user rule 2026-07-26). Liberation of Mazcab, Achto tank sets, Mazcab ability codex, and teci imbues densify under Desert.
cross_boundary_cases.evidence_note: User taxonomy 2026-07-26: Mazcab → Desert elective packaging for planner region pressure.
